name: Elpro International Ltd
about: Elpro International Limited is engaged in manufacturing surge arresters, construction and development of real estate properties, equity investment in third parties and windmill operations. [1]
keyPoints:
Business Segments

Elpro - It brings a complete range of Dynamic and High-performance Surge suppression products for the complete spectrum of High & Low voltage [1]
